subject: I think I found an error/exception in read.transcript.features() with Candida annotations.

messages.author: 7f28753c909e9d5e
messages.subject: I think I found an error/exception in read.transcript.features() with Candida annotations.
parts:
Once I'm working with Candida and the annotations are not complete, I only have one "big exon" and don't know where the introns are.
Because of this fact bed12.to.intros throws an exception.

To remove this exception I wrote these last 3 lines

bed12.to.introns<-function(ref)
{
  ref=ref[ref[,10]>1,]

  if (nrow(ref) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  ...
}


and at the end of read.transcript.features()
 ....

      if (is.null(introns))
        GRangesList(exons=exons)
      else
        GRangesList(exons=exons,introns=introns,promoters=prom,TSSes=tssg)

thanks
Flavio

parts:
Dear Altuna,

   Now methylkit works ... without introns in the reference genome (from Candida).

in read.transcript.features,

I changed these lines:

bed12.to.introns<-function(ref)
{
  #remove the genes with one exon only (they won't have any introns)
  ref=ref[ref[,10]>1,]
   #--------------- here -----------------
  if (nrow(ref) == 0) {
    return(GenomicRanges::GRanges())
  }
  #--------------- here -----------------
  ....


  The gff file can be found at:
  http://www.candidagenome.org/download/gff/C_albicans_SC5314/

  file: C_albicans_SC5314_A22_current_features.gff

  Before running, if necessary, kill the header lines.

thanks
Flavio
